_comment: Third-party partner/integration marks — NOT OpenMined's brand. Each is the trademark of its owner, used nominatively to identify the tool. Sourced from official brand resources (or CC0 Simple Icons glyphs for monochrome icons). Never recolor a mark where the owner's guidelines forbid it; never imply endorsement. OMDS color tokens do NOT apply to these. Icons named `icon.svg` use fill=currentColor (theme via `color`); `icon-color.svg` carries the official brand color.

github.name: GitHub
github.notes: Official (GitHub_Logos.zip). Monochrome by design — use black or white only per GitHub guidelines. Icon = Invertocat.

ramp.name: Ramp
ramp.notes: Official production SVG (next.ramp.com), verified byte-identical to ramp.com header. Monochrome by design (currentColor). No separately-published icon-only mark.

google.name: Google
google.notes: icon-color = the official 4-color 'G' artwork (#4285F4/#EA4335/#FBBC05/#34A853) — DO NOT recolor (Google guidelines). icon.svg is the generic monochrome G glyph (Simple Icons) for single-color contexts. There is NO official 'Google Workspace' suite lockup SVG, and app-icon use is partner-gated.
gaps: Google Workspace suite lockup (no official SVG exists)

notion.name: Notion
notion.notes: Monochrome by design (black + reversed white). Icon = the 'N'. Color == mono.
gaps: wordmark lockup (in official zip; not yet added)

asana.name: Asana
asana.notes: Asana discourages standalone use of the 3-dot symbol — prefer the lockup where possible. Never place on a coral background.
gaps: official lockup (in brand kit; not yet added)

slack.name: Slack
slack.notes: icon-color = the official 4-color hash from Slack's CDN (#E01E5A/#36C5F0/#2EB67D/#ECB22E) — never recolor. icon.svg is a monochrome glyph. The wordmark lockup is gated behind Salesforce's Widen DAM.

claude.name: Claude
claude.notes: Official (Anthropic press kit). Icon = the Claude Spark (clay #D97757). Lockup in Slate (default), Ivory (on dark), and one-color.

hubspot.name: HubSpot
hubspot.notes: Sprocket mark. HubSpot gates official logo files (request/partner program) — referential use only, keep your name more prominent, include an independence disclaimer.

1password.name: 1Password
1password.notes: Official lockup from the press CDN (mono black + white). Recent rebrand ships separate company and product marks — verify which is intended.

rippling.name: Rippling
rippling.notes: icon = the official 'R' mark from Rippling's production CDN (monochrome, currentColor). The full wordmark lockup suite is gated behind a Google Drive share + their developer Brand Guide.
